name: Seeing Through Fog — Adverse Weather Sensor Benchmark
description: Multimodal automotive sensor dataset created by Ulm University, Princeton University, and Mercedes-Benz AG to benchmark perception under extreme weather. Collected over 10,000 km of driving across Northern Europe and in controlled fog chambers. Pairs high-resolution gated near-infrared active cameras with stereo RGB cameras, Velodyne scanning LiDAR, Continental radar, and thermal sensors, offering 12,000 multi-modal samples with 2D and 3D bounding boxes in dense fog, rain, and snow.
